findings.description: Nit: agent-coordinator/src/profile_loader.py:141-144 treats a non-mapping KV-v2 data payload as success by warning and returning {}. Task 3.7 cites CFG-22 fail-closed internal loading; a malformed secret/coordinator document therefore starts the process with an empty secrets map instead of raising, which can mask a bad mount/path/response shape behind missing interpolations.
findings.resolution: If response/data/data is missing or not a dict, raise a sanitized RuntimeError (no raw hvac body) and cover the shapes in test_profile_loader.

findings.description: Nit: agent-coordinator/src/openbao_identity.py:54-55 rejects incomplete/duplicate keys with BaoCredentialError(SECRET_MALFORMED, "identity") and the audited refresh_failed record never names the failing registry agent. AI-04 requires the sanitized error to identify the affected principal(s); safe SPIFFE/agent_path identifiers are allowed by the event contract and would make COORD-02 failures operable.
findings.resolution: Include the failing agent SPIFFE or agents/<name> path in the raised error context and/or openbao.identity.refresh_failed resource/principal fields without logging key material; assert the identifier appears and the raw key does not.
findings.existing_code:
if not isinstance(key, str) or not key.strip() or key in result:
            raise BaoCredentialError(ErrorCode.SECRET_MALFORMED, "identity")

findings.description: Optional: when the monotonic grace window elapses, lookup/readiness deny authentication and flip identity to degraded, but IdentityRuntime never emits openbao.identity.snapshot_expired even though contracts/openbao-event.schema.json defines that event and action=expire. Operators must infer expiry from /ready alone after the last refresh_failed.
findings.resolution: On the first transition past GRACE_SECONDS for an installed snapshot, emit one schema-valid openbao.identity.snapshot_expired failure event (no key material) and add a contract test for single emission under concurrent lookup/readiness.

findings.description: Optional: clearing config.api.api_key_identities whenever BAO_ADDR is set leaves langfuse_middleware._resolve_agent_id reading an empty map, so authenticated Bao-mode requests are traced as agent_id cloud-agent. Auth correctly uses the snapshot; this is telemetry mis-attribution only. langfuse_middleware.py is outside wp-coordinator write_allow.
findings.resolution: Escalate to extend write_allow or a follow-up package so _resolve_agent_id consults IdentityRuntime.lookup (or another snapshot-backed helper) in Bao mode.

findings.description: none: Bao-mode request authorization matches D4/COORD-09: _principal_for_api_key uses only IdentityRuntime.lookup, ApiConfig drops static COORDINATION_API_KEY_IDENTITIES when BAO_ADDR is set, and cutover preflight blocks unbound COORDINATION_API_KEYS entries before the first install.

none: atomic snapshot install, monotonic 120s grace shared by lookup and readiness, /ready identity ready|degraded|disabled with 200-during-grace / 503-when-unusable, and schema-valid sanitized refresh_* audit events match D4 and contracts/openapi/v1.yaml plus openbao-event.schema.json.

none: D5 separation holds — OpenBaoConfig/profile_loader authenticate only with BAO_INTERNAL_ROLE_ID/BAO_INTERNAL_SECRET_ID against secret/coordinator, while identity reload uses PrincipalOpenBaoConfig + identity-reader; legacy BAO_ROLE_ID/BAO_SECRET_ID cannot authenticate the internal loader.
